Tell me exactly how to setup https://github.com/Synthetixio/synpress on a Macbook Pro.

Sure, I can guide you through the process of setting up Synpress on your Macbook Pro. Please follow these steps:

  1. Install Node.js: Synpress is built using Node.js, so you need to make sure it is installed on your Macbook Pro. To check if Node.js is installed on your computer, open the Terminal app and type node -v. If you get a version number in response, it means Node.js is already installed. Otherwise, you can download and install it from the official Node.js website: https://nodejs.org/en/download/.

  2. Install Yarn: Synpress uses Yarn as a package manager. To install Yarn, open the Terminal app and run the following command:

npm install -g yarn
  1. Clone the Synpress repository: Open the Terminal app and navigate to the directory where you want to store the Synpress code. Then, run the following command to clone the Synpress repository:
bash
git clone https://github.com/Synthetixio/synpress.git
  1. Install dependencies: Navigate to the Synpress directory by running cd synpress in the Terminal app, and then run the following command to install the dependencies:
yarn install
  1. Configure environment variables: Synpress requires some environment variables to be set up before it can be used. Create a .env file in the root of the Synpress directory, and add the following variables:
makefile
NETWORK=mainnet
INFURA_KEY=<your Infura API key>
PRIVATE_KEY=<your private key>

Replace <your Infura API key> and <your private key> with your actual Infura API key and private key, respectively. The NETWORK variable should be set to mainnet or kovan depending on the network you want to use.
